It preserves the Harness model list, adds a small glasses control to eligible mo"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"dels, and delegates image analysis to a separately configured vision provider."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The plugin supports Gemini-native, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions/Responses, and Anthropic-compa"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"tible Messages APIs. The selected vision provider returns bounded text analysis; image blocks are ne"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ver forwarded directly to the active upstream model."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **One model list:** Vision Bridge no longer appears as a duplicated provider group.
- **Per-model "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"glasses toggle:** Gray means the bridge preference is off; blue means it is on.
- **Selection stays "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"explicit:** Clicking the glasses only changes the preference. Clicking the model name selects the mo"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"del and applies that preference.
- **Persistent without model churn:** Glasses preferences are remem"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"bered in the Harness web client without triggering a model switch or model-directory refresh.
- **Cl"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ear service provenance:** Hover the glasses to see the active vision provider and model.
- **Multipl"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"e vision providers:** Add, switch, and delete isolated provider profiles from Settings.
- **Native-v"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ision aware:** Models that already advertise image input do not receive a bridge toggle.
- **Reasoni"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ng UI preserved:** The original Harness reasoning-effort menu remains unchanged."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Model selector behavior"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Control | Result |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Gray glasses | Vision Bridge is disabled for that model. |
| Blue glasses | Vision Bridge is enabl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ed for that model. |
| Click glasses | Toggle and remember the preference only; the selected model d"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"oes not change. |
| Click model name/row | Select the model. Blue routes through Vision Bridge; gray"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" uses the normal upstream route. |
| Hover glasses | Show the vision provider and model that will pe"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"rform image understanding. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The glasses control appears only when a matching bridge route exists and the upstream model is text-"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"only or has unknown image capability. The preference is stored per upstream model in the local Harne"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s unknown image capability. The preference is stored per upstream model in the local Harness client."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. Enable the glasses for an eligible text-first model, then click the model name to select it.
2. A"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ttach an image and ask a visual question normally.
3. Harness validates and stores the attachment in"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" the session.
4. The bridge route replaces image blocks only in the provider-bound request copy with"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" controlled attachment markers. The original session and transcript keep the images.
5. The active u"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"pstream model calls `vision_bridge`; the tool reads the latest session image through Harness attachm"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ent services.
6. The plugin sends a bounded request to the configured vision provider and returns on"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ly its text analysis to the active agent."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Explicit workspace paths remain supported through `image_paths`; they are resolved with Harness file"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"pace paths remain supported through `image_paths`; they are resolved with Harness filesystem policy."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.5` or a compatible `0.1.x` release
- Node.js `^22.19` or `>=24`
- An up"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"stream model route that supports Harness tool calls
- An API key for at least one image-capable endp"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"am model route that supports Harness tool calls
- An API key for at least one image-capable endpoint"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The backward-compatible default profile uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, the Gemini native endpoint, and `gemi"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ompatible default profile uses `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, the Gemini native endpoint, and `gemini-3.6-flash`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### From GitHub"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Install the highest semantic-version release tag:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`#semver:*` selects the newest matching GitHub version tag. Pin an exact tag such as `#v0.2.0` when "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"reproducible installs are required."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"If Harness is started with `npx`:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The persistent `web` profile is stored under `~/.dsh/profiles/web` unless `DSH_HOME` is changed."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### From a checkout"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The config dump should contain a `dsh-vision-bridge` layer and a `vision-bridge` row."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Configure vision providers"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → Image understanding**."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Each provider profile contains:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- a display name;
- an HTTPS Base URL;
- an API format (`auto`, Gemini, OpenAI compatible, or Anthro"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"pic compatible);
- its own credential;
- a selected image-capable model."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Adding a provider first verifies its model-list endpoint. The credential is stored through Harness c"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"redential services; the complete key is never returned to the browser. Switching providers immediate"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ly updates the glasses tooltip, including the selected provider name and model."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- Images are sent to the configured vision endpoint. Do not use an endpoint that is not allowed to r"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"eceive them.
- Only HTTPS provider endpoints are accepted.
- File formats are detected from bytes in"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"stead of trusted extensions.
- Per-image, aggregate-image, question, response, answer, token, and ti"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"me limits are enforced.
- API keys are resolved Host-side and are never included in tool results or "},{"id":"p39s5","text":"browser responses.
- Text inside images is treated as untrusted evidence, not as an instruction."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- Provider requests send image bytes inline; remote image URLs and file/video upload APIs are not su"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"pported.
- Unknown Base URLs default to OpenAI compatibility unless `apiFormat` is explicit.
- The b"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"ridge returns the provider's text analysis; it does not independently verify OCR, measurements, or s"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"afety-critical conclusions.
- Custom `llm/stream` middleware observes both the bridge request and it"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"s delegated upstream request."}],"truncated":true}
